notes.title: Unidentified Falling Objects is available now on Steam and Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=oMAAz6hugoA;full][/previewyoutube]
Unidentified Falling Objects (UFO) is available now on Steam and Nintendo Switch! A free demo is also available on both Steam and Nintendo Switch.

UFO is a puzzle-platformer title that drops you directly into quirky and colorful puzzle boards to dodge falling obstacles, set up combos, and blast blocks to survive as long as possible and achieve the high score. Play through a variety of stages in the game’s single player campaign or jump into local multiplayer for heated one versus one battles, or head online and compete against up to 20 other players.

In UFO, you can explore multiple worlds through the game’s single player mode and meet a colorful cast of characters who are ready to puts your puzzle solving skills to the test with unique challenges that will keep even the most puzzle-hardened veterans on their toes. You can customize your loadout with unique weapons, movement styles, and kicks, allowing for multiple play styles that best suit a particular puzzle’s challenge. All of this is wrapped in quirky and colorful retro style graphics and an energizing synthwave soundtrack.

notes.title: Unidentified Falling Objects – New Launch Date
notes.notes:
To make sure Unidentified Falling Objects can be launched around the world simultaneously for Steam and console, we decided to shift the release date from July 18th to August 9th. In other words, we decided to go for a bigger 10-block combo rather than knocking out single one-off blocks to reach our goal of getting UFO out to all our wonderful fans. 

A demo for UFO is currently available on Steam that gives players access to the first world of the game’s single player campaign and get a taste of its fiendish puzzles and challenges. We look forward to everyone kicking and blasting their way through the full version of UFO in less than a month on August 9th!
